Mention the benefits of the hobby and why you enjoy it. Use a friendly greeting and closing.

Hey there! Hope you're doing well. I just wanted to share something fun I've been into lately – rock climbing! I joined a local gym and it's been a real adventure. It's like a mix of strength training and problem-solving. Each climb is a puzzle to figure out and it's incredibly rewarding to conquer one.

The best part is how it's really boosted my confidence. I feel so much stronger and more capable. Plus, the community is so cool. Everyone is super supportive and welcoming. It's really given me a great sense of accomplishment. 

I'm thinking of signing up for a beginner's class soon too. Maybe you could come check it out with me? I'd love to share the excitement and maybe even make some new climbing buddies. Let me know what you think! 

Hope to hear from you soon. Take care!
- [Your Name] 

(End of message) 

This message highlights the enjoyment and benefits of rock climbing in a casual, friendly way. It includes a specific invitation for the friend to join in as well.
